title: 01 / Purchasing control flow
purpose: A closed success/rejection graph with explicit decision branches.

title: 02 / Shared responsibility assignments
purpose: These exact task and relationship identities also generate the RACI matrix.

title: 03 / Model-derived RACI
purpose: One A and at least one R required per row. Cells select the original assignments.

title: 04 / Model-derived CRUD
purpose: Source-bound access cells, not a separately maintained spreadsheet.

title: 05 / Numbered Gane–Sarson-style DFD
purpose: Same DFD participants and transfers; two registered notations.

title: 06 / Yourdon-style DFD
purpose: Same DFD participants and transfers; two registered notations.

title: 07 / Declared class / interface subset
purpose: Attributes and operations have separate compartments; UML parameter/type semantics remain out of scope.

title: 08 / Actor and use-case subset
purpose: Actors, ellipses, include and extend; not full UML conformance.

title: 09 / Requirement traceability
purpose: Requirement IDs/text and typed verification/implementation links.

title: 10 / Entity-field representation
purpose: Entity fields are shared with the Chen projection.

title: 11 / Chen binary projection
purpose: The attribute ovals and relationship diamonds are view occurrences of existing fields/relations.

title: 12 / Synthetic monthly value — bar
purpose: Same six source records across marks. Quantitative coordinates remain exact under style changes.

title: 13 / Synthetic monthly value — line
purpose: Same six source records across marks. Quantitative coordinates remain exact under style changes.

title: 14 / Synthetic monthly value — area
purpose: Same six source records across marks. Quantitative coordinates remain exact under style changes.

title: 15 / Synthetic monthly value — pie
purpose: Same six source records across marks. Quantitative coordinates remain exact under style changes.

title: 16 / Synthetic monthly value — donut
purpose: Same six source records across marks. Quantitative coordinates remain exact under style changes.

title: 17 / Cost versus recorded value
purpose: Bubble area uses a square-root radius mapping; record counts are not added to currency.

title: 18 / UTC monthly observations
purpose: Date positions come from source values, not graph placement.

title: 19 / Shared observation table
purpose: Inspect values that feed the chart projections.

title: 20 / Declarative decision-table presentation
purpose: Conditions/actions are documentation. No FEEL/hit-policy execution is implied.

title: 21 / Supplied-date procurement schedule
purpose: UTC, end-exclusive dates with finish-to-start guards; no scheduler or resource leveling.

title: 22 / Schedule source records
purpose: These are the same task objects visible in flowchart and RACI.

title: 23 / Reusable SWOT panel template
purpose: Measured text determines row heights; spans cannot overlap.

title: 24 / SIPOC from shared notes
purpose: Five explicit panels reuse model definitions.

title: 25 / Service journey with spanning panels
purpose: Span-aware layout, not yet a rich widget/emotion-chart compositor.

title: 26 / General relationship matrix
purpose: A general cross-tab uses relationship text rather than RACI codes; source identities remain the same.

title: 27 / Composable semantic silhouettes
purpose: Inventory only: disconnected shapes are not a valid control-flow process.
